Question
========
Researchers calculated a 95% confidence interval of the average family size of Canadians to be from 2.7 to 3.1, based on a sample of 500 families with a standard deviation of 1.1. What change would produce a more precise estimate?

Answerlist
----------

* Increasing our sample size to 600

* Increasing our standard deviation to 1.3

* Increasing our confidence interval to 99%

* Improving our sampling strategy
